notes: STF/Naturkartan list Piteälven-Gásakláhko as 19 km, but publish no endpoint coordinate. WFS 19 km split is 66.5839492,17.2754676. OSM/Wikidata/Mapcarta campsite is 66.6202912,17.2744719, about 4.04 km north and about 14.8 km from the official start.
OSM relation 18864493 is tagged distance=19 but computes 14.497 km; relation 18864494 is tagged 13 but computes 16.098 km. Both share the OSM campsite boundary.
Official sources and Lantmäteriet support Gásakláhko as a broad Lulesami terrain/highland place-name; route apps and OSM use a discrete campsite point.
WFS BD77/BD78 handoff 66.71854496,17.34937659, Naturkartan BD78 GPX first point 66.7190103,17.3468528 and OSM campsite/stage point 66.7163830,17.3412810 differ by up to about 429 m.
Official STF/Naturkartan distance is 19 km; AllTrails/route-app/OSM-style routes show about 14.5-17.2 km depending convention; Cicerone uses Gistojávrátj-Gásakláhko 19.7 km.
Map sources may imply shelter/basic hut, while Naturkartan and field reports describe poor condition and unreliable shelter.
OSM has boat/ferry-like metadata near Piteälven, but official sources and field reports indicate suspension bridge crossing and no required ferry on section 15.
